name: Bob Kasten
summary: Robert Walter Kasten Jr. (born June 19, 1942) is an American government affairs consultant, lobbyist, and former Republican politician from Wisconsin.  He served 12 years as a United States senator, representing Wisconsin from 1981 to 1993, and served four years in the U.S. House of Representatives, representing Wisconsin's 9th congressional district from 1975 to 1979.
